jobs.name: rs-subject
jobs.prompt: IDENTITY: the reference photos show ONE woman, the HNK model — keep her EXACT face in every detail: an oval face with soft full cheeks and a gently rounded chin, large almond-shaped dark-brown eyes with long lashes and a softly winged liner, well-defined arched brows, a small straight nose, full soft-pink lips, fair porcelain skin, early twenties, long thick wavy dark-brown hair. Same person, same face shape, same eyes, nose, lips and jawline as the references — do not redesign, slim, age, harden or replace her. LOOK: fair luminous porcelain skin retouched flawless and glass-smooth over face and body (no visible pores, no blemishes, no dark knees or elbows), soft glam, a clean cool-toned colour grade (neutral-cool whites and greys, no orange or yellow cast on her skin), delicate and pretty. Change everything else as described. Create a half-body photograph of the HNK model from the references (the same face, fair luminous porcelain skin, long dark wavy hair, soft natural glam), early twenties, slim, elegant, standing in a plain light-grey photo studio (plain grey backdrop, plain grey floor, nothing else), wearing a white ribbed knit top and light-blue straight jeans, hair loose over the shoulders, hands relaxed at her sides, a soft natural smile straight into the camera, soft even shadowless light (a plain subject photograph waiting for a scene), 50mm lens, HORIZONTAL 3:2 framing with open room on both sides of her, photoreal, no text, no captions, no watermark, no logo.
